title: Performance
ownerScopeDisabledTitle: You can only view your own stats
emptyGoalsBody: A goal sets a target for a person or the team over a period you choose.
emptyFunnel: No deals were created in this range, so there is no funnel to measure.
emptyStageSums: No open deals in these stages.
emptyLostReasons: No deals were lost in this range.
emptyGoals: No goals apply to you yet.
emptyWonTrend: No deals were won in this range, so there is no trend to draw.
funnelBasisMe: Counts only deals you own that were created in this range.
funnelBasisAll: Counts deals created in this range, whoever owns them.
funnelBasisUser: Counts only deals the selected person owns that were created in this range.
funnelBasisTeam: Counts only deals the selected team owns that were created in this range.

_extra.trendDeals: {amount} from {count, plural, one {# deal} other {# deals}}
_extra.bucketNotice: Monthly trends use Gregorian calendar months.
_extra.goalPeriodNotice: Goal periods start from each goal's start date. Monthly, quarterly and yearly periods use Gregorian calendar arithmetic.
_extra.recordsCount: {count, plural, one {# eligible deal} other {# eligible deals}}

subtitle: Your sales results, pipeline and team activity.
retryExplanation: Your filters are still selected. Try loading this report again.
invalidRange: Choose an end date on or after the start date.
pipelinesUnavailable: Pipeline options could not be loaded.
ownersUnavailable: People and team options could not be loaded.
goalsScopeNotice: Goals that apply to you use their own dates and scope, independently of the report filters.
wonBasis: Deals won in the selected period
cycleDefinition: From creation to win, for deals won in this period
pipelineExplanation: Added, won and lost use their respective event dates. Open deals and stage values show the current pipeline.
activityExplanation: Completed uses completion dates; scheduled counts open activities due in the period. These are separate groups, not a completion rate.
snapshotNotice: Current open deals · independent of the date range
recordsEmpty: No visible deals meet this measure’s eligibility rules in the selected scope.
recordsUnavailable: Contributing deals could not be loaded. Your report scope is still selected.
recordsScopeChanged: The original chart scope is unavailable. Reopen the month from the current chart.
recordsExportLimit: Narrow the report to download up to {count, number} deals.
recordsOpenNewTab: Opens in a new tab; this report stays open
recordsLiveNotice: Live results use current owners, visibility and deal status. Reopening, corrections or permission changes can restate earlier results; pages may change as records are edited.
recordsAddedBasis: Deals created in this period, regardless of their current outcome.
recordsWonBasis: Currently won deals whose win date is in this period. Won deal value is not invoiced or collected revenue.
recordsLostBasis: Currently lost deals whose loss date is in this period.
recordsOpenBasis: Currently open deals. The selected period does not limit this inventory.
recordsClosedBasis: Currently won or lost deals whose corresponding close date is in this period. Won deals form the win-rate numerator; all listed deals form its denominator.
recordsWonValueBasis: Currently won deals closed in this period with a recorded value. Only these values enter the average; a recorded zero is included.
recordsWonCycleBasis: Currently won deals closed in this period whose win date is on or after creation. Each listed deal contributes one creation-to-win duration to the median.
funnelLegacyNotice: Includes inferred passage through earlier stages using the current stage order. Elapsed time combines completed stays and current open age. All-pipeline results combine stage positions.
presetCalendarGregorian: Month, quarter and year presets follow the Gregorian calendar and end today.
presetCalendarPersian: Month, quarter and year presets follow the Iranian Solar Hijri calendar and end today.

stageAging.title: Stage aging
stageAging.coverage: Observed stage stays since capture began for deals you can currently view in this report scope. The cohort includes open and still-visible closed deals.
stageAging.currentLabels: Stage and pipeline names reflect the definitions at the time of this report.
stageAging.censoring: A stay already underway when capture began provides a lower bound. Only stays with an observed entry contribute to percentiles.
stageAging.noDeals: No current deals match this scope.
stageAging.noStays: There are no qualifying stage stays in this cohort.
stageAging.permission: Your current permissions do not allow you to view this report.
stageAging.capture: Stage history is unavailable for this workspace.
stageAging.read: Stage aging is unavailable for this scope.
stageAging.cohortScope: This report uses the current cohort for the selected pipeline, owner, and currency. Dashboard dates apply to the period-based reports.
stageAging.ownDealsOnly: This report covers your own deals.

cohort.title: Deal cohorts by age
cohort.definition: Compare deals still in the CRM and visible to you, including closed deals. Each monthly group includes only observed deal starts. Every group is measured at the same elapsed age. The selected dates limit which starts count in each month.
cohort.outcomeRangeBasis: The lower bound counts confirmed wins among deals that reached this age. The upper bound also counts every missing outcome among those deals as a win. The range is rounded outward.
cohort.partial: Only part of the selected range is covered. The figures describe the covered days in each month.
cohort.empty: No eligible deal starts were recorded in the covered range.
cohort.noCapture: Deal history capture has not started. Earlier deal starts cannot be reconstructed from current records.
cohort.noPeriod: The selected dates do not overlap the captured deal history.
cohort.unavailable: Deal cohort results are unavailable for these filters.
cohort.ownDealsOnly: This report is limited to your own deals.

recordedSource.title: Recorded deal sources
recordedSource.definition: Deals are grouped by the channel on their current CRM record. Added uses the recorded creation date. Won and lost use the current outcome and its recorded date. A deal can count toward both added and an outcome.
recordedSource.samples: {count, number} of {total, plural, one {# win} other {# wins}}
recordedSource.sampleBasis: Nominal value sums the recorded amounts for wins with an amount in the selected currency. Average cycle includes wins dated on or after recorded creation. Each sample count uses that channel's won deals.
recordedSource.empty: No eligible deals were added, won, or lost in this period.
recordedSource.permission: Your current permissions do not allow you to view this report.
recordedSource.unavailable: Recorded deal sources are unavailable for these filters.

currentHandoff.title: Lead-to-deal links
currentHandoff.definition: The date range selects leads by their creation date. Linked deals are counted when they are active and visible to you now. Handoff and first-response timing require recorded events.
currentHandoff.ownLeadsOnly: This report covers your own leads.
currentHandoff.empty: No leads were created in this period for these filters.
currentHandoff.permission: Your current permissions do not allow you to view this report.
currentHandoff.allPipelines: Choose All pipelines to see the report. Leads have no pipeline before conversion.
currentHandoff.unavailable: Lead-to-deal links are unavailable for these filters.

currentAttention.title: Deal next actions
currentAttention.definition: These counts use the current pipeline, owner and currency. Overdue work follows the activity queue’s account time zone. An open deal needs a next step when it has no unfinished linked activity.
currentAttention.dealsWithoutNextStep: Open deals without a next step
currentAttention.permission: Your current permissions do not allow you to view this report.
currentAttention.unavailable: Current next-action counts are unavailable for these filters.
currentAttention.matchLimit: This scope has too many matches for a complete count. Choose a narrower scope.

savedPerformance.title: Saved Performance reports
savedPerformance.definition: Save the selected pipeline, owner, currency, and fixed dates as a private definition. Review saved filters to check whether the scope is still available.
savedPerformance.name: Report name
savedPerformance.runResult: Current results for the saved filters
savedPerformance.runUnavailable: The saved report could not be run.
savedPerformance.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the private saved definition.
savedPerformance.unsupported: This saved definition uses an unsupported version.
savedPerformance.scopeUnavailable: This exact scope is no longer available.
savedPerformance.invalidDefinition: The saved definition could not be read.
savedPerformance.reviewUnavailable: The saved filters could not be reviewed.
savedPerformance.listUnavailable: Your saved definitions could not be loaded.
savedPerformance.empty: You have no saved Performance definitions.
savedPerformance.truncated: This list shows the most recent definitions.
savedPerformance.invalidSave: Check the report name and fixed dates.
savedPerformance.reportLimit: You have reached the private definition limit. Delete one to add another.
savedPerformance.saveFailed: The definition could not be saved.
savedPerformance.deleteFailed: The definition could not be deleted.

forecast.title: Period forecast scenarios
forecast.definition: Run manual scenarios for the current pipeline, owner and currency. The same assumptions apply to each eligible open deal. The results show what could happen under those assumptions.
forecast.assumptionsHelp: Enter probabilities from 0 to 100 percent. Timing is the chance of closing during the target period given a win. Leave a probability blank if unknown. The size multiplier defaults to 1 when blank.
forecast.timingProbability: Chance of closing in the period if won (%)
forecast.invalid: Choose a future period of up to 366 days, probabilities from 0 to 100, and multipliers from 0 to 10.
forecast.unavailable: The forecast is unavailable for this scope.
forecast.captureUnavailable: Deal history capture is required for the forecast and is currently unavailable.

currentAccount.title: Won value by linked organization
currentAccount.definition: This report uses nominal CRM amounts and each won deal’s current organization link. Both records must be visible to you. The multiple-wins count covers organizations with at least two won deals in the selected period. Confirmed expansion and settled financial results require separate evidence.
currentAccount.linkedWonDeals: Won deals with a visible linked organization
currentAccount.unresolvedWonDeals: Won deals without a resolved organization
currentAccount.linkedWonDealsWithoutValue: Linked won deals without a recorded amount
currentAccount.linkedKnownNominalNet: Recorded nominal total for linked wins
currentAccount.ownWinsOnly: This report covers your own won deals.
currentAccount.concentrationBasis: Shares use the total of positive organization nets. Each net adds that organization’s recorded deal amounts, including negatives. Displayed shares are rounded to one decimal place.
currentAccount.unresolvedConcentration: Concentration is unavailable until every won deal in scope has a visible linked organization.
currentAccount.missingValueConcentration: Concentration is unavailable until every linked won deal has a recorded amount.
currentAccount.noPositiveNet: No linked organization has a positive net won value in this period.
currentAccount.empty: There are no won deals in this scope and period.
currentAccount.permission: Your current access does not allow you to see this report.
currentAccount.scopeUnavailable: This pipeline or report scope is unavailable.
currentAccount.unavailable: Won value by linked organization is unavailable for these filters.
